parts.label: Early vote
why: Registered Democrats cast 43% of the 806,727 ballots in Oregon so far, against 31% for the other party.
That is 4.6 points better for Democrats than the forecast expected by now.
Statewide numbers; this weighs less for a House race.

parts.label: National tide
why: Gallup party identification moved from Republicans 48 Democrats 45 in the third quarter of 2024 to Democrats 50 Republicans 39 in the third quarter of 2026, 14 points toward the Democrats.
This district moves 1.02 points for every point the nation moves, so it feels about 14.3 points of that tide, a tailwind for Maxine Dexter.

D.t: Maxine Dexter leads by 56.0 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 190,388 votes; a one point swing is about 1,701 voters changing sides.
